name: shared-axis-z
title: Shared Axis Z
description: Words scale into place one after another along the depth axis, swelling up from small or settling down from large. Entrance only; the clip end takes it off. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="shared-axis-z": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Which way the words travel along the z axis: in swells up from small, out settles down from large.

variables.label: Depth
variables.description: Scales how far the words start from their final size, so the push covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
